body.p: By this Preliminary Amendment, Applicant amends the specification to insert
reference to the related applications, for which the benefit of priority is claimed for this application.
By this Preliminary Amendment, Applicant cancels claims 1-64 and adds claims 65-85. The new claims are fully supported by the application as-filed. No new matter is added.
Applicant respectfully requests favorable consideration and timely allowance of this application.

This application claims the benefit of an earlier filed U.S. nonprovisional patent application. To the extent that the claims in this application have the same or similar terms to those in the parent application, Applicant hereby rescinds any disclaimers originating from arguments made during the prosecution of the parent application. Applicant invites the Examiner to revisit the relevant prior art of the parent application. Hakim v. Cannon A vent Group, 479 F.3d 1313 (Fed. Cir. 2007).
If the Examiner believes a telephone conversation might advance prosecution, the Examiner is invited to call Applicant's undersigned representative at 202- 618.7081.

Please grant any extensions of time required to enter this response and charge any additional required fees to Deposit Account No. 50-5906. In addition, the Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees due and any other fees due under 37 C.F.R. § 1.16 or § 1.17 during the pendency of this application to Deposit Account No. 50-5906.
Dated: February 8, 2024 By: /Stephen J. E. Dew/
